pages.name: Sicilian: Loewenthal, Kalashnikov, Main Line, 9.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the knight route as c2-e3 from a3; plan 3 'exchanged light-squared bishops' with Bxc6, which the e2-bishop cannot play; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in the overview. Plan 4 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-16 (reviewer: first draft's queen set-up was not standard and missed ...Bg5).

pages.name: Classical Sicilian
pages.notes: Plan 4 named c4 as a move. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Lasker-Pelikan Variation, Bird Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the knight route as Nc2-e3 from a3; plan 3 named e3 and d4 as moves; plan 4 traded a light-squared bishop for no clear reason. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Open, 2...Nc6, 5...Qb6 6.Nb3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Black a minority attack against a d4-pawn White doesn't have. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, 7.a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the knight via a3-c2 'to control d4'; plan 2 used a bishop pair Black doesn't have. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, 7.a4
pages.notes: Plan 4 named c4 as a move; plan 1 sent the knight to c2 rather than the usual c4. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, 7.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight and claimed the bishop pair before any exchange. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, 7.Bg5 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote ...b5-b4 into the knight; plan 4 sent a knight to an f5 'outpost' rather than the ...f5 break. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, 7.Bg5 a6 8.Bxf6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 called the g-file open (half-open after ...gxf6); plan 1 routed the knight Na3-c4-d5 from b5 and claimed the dark squares after White gave up the dark-squared bishop; plan 2 played ...f5 before recapturing. Rewrote plans 1-2 and fixed the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, 7.Nd5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 called the d5-pawn passed (Black's d6-pawn stands in front of it); plan 2 rerouted a knight from b8 that stands on c6. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Loewenthal, 5...a6
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-14: the overview still describes a weak d6-pawn rather than 6.Nd6+ Bxd6 7.Qxd6. Two rewrites were rejected (first: dark squares said to be White's weakness; second: d5 called a dark square). Old text kept.
